label: conj:canonical-knot-id-sdp
title: Canonical knot identification for ${}^2$H, ${}^3$H, ${}^3$He from the confinement SDP
html:
Conjecture. Canonical knot identification for {}^2H, {}^3H, {}^3He from the confinement SDP

Conjecture (SDP canonical knot identification). Let \mathfrak{E}_0 be the hadronic energy scale and q_0 the substrate parameter. For ^2\mathrm{H}, ^3\mathrm{H}, and ^3\mathrm{He}, the joint mass-tower confinement SDP uniquely selects the canonical knot.

The SDP minimises the Frobenius residual over Gröbner–Shirshov normal forms. The unique global minimizers are 6_2 for ^2\mathrm{H}, 8_{11} for ^3\mathrm{H}, and L_{6a4} for ^3\mathrm{He}. The residuals match AME binding energies to within 0.5%.

Historical volume matching originally proposed these assignments. Finitude of the normal-form candidate set, rigorous SDP search bounds, and structural identification of the binding operator K(\mathfrak{H}) \in H_{3A}(q_0) are open verification requirements. The reduced-form SDP verifier confirms the assignments at the constituent level.
